annotations.evidence: the maintainer's print read 2026-10-22: "This is a case that needs annotation.  The print version has a scan error, such that the letter is missing the decender (does not even have the little bit that yod would have.)   Based on the cites and word order, I am confident in vav, but we want that noted." Three cites spell `אֻרְוָה`, all linked here (A00863, A00878, A00879); its plural is `אֻרְווֹת`; it stands between A03019 `אָרוֹד` and A03021 `אַרְוָוד`, where `ארוה` sorts. 116a · leaf 139.

senses.gloss: f. (b. h.; v. אוּרְיָא II) manger, crib.—Pl. אֻרְווֹת.
